name: vscode-sugar
description: Thin VS Code host for sugar-lsp --in-process. Report mode, prove, and diagnostics live in the LANGUAGE SERVER — not in this extension.

sugar.lsp.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the `sugar-lsp` binary. The extension spawns `sugar-lsp --in-process` over stdio as a vscode-languageclient LanguageClient; the server builds a resident ProveContext from the workspace root and solves every edited python/rust buffer in-process (no daemon, no cold shell-out). Resolve it with `bin/sugarbin --bin sugar-lsp`.

sugar.debounceMs.description: Debounce window for re-linking on keystrokes.

sugar.prove.pythonBinDir.description: Prepended onto PATH for the sugar-lsp child (python lifter binaries).

sugar.prove.pythonPath.description: Prepended onto PYTHONPATH for the sugar-lsp child (sugar-lift-py-* src roots).

sugar.prove.rustBinDir.description: Prepended onto PATH for the sugar-lsp child when rust lifters need cargo/rustc helpers.
